display.name: Salesforce CRM
display.summary: Reads and searches the Salesforce records, schema, and relationships available to the signed-in user.
examples: Which opportunities over $100,000 are currently in the pipeline?
Summarize the cases opened for Acme Corp in the last 7 days.
Find the contacts and open opportunities related to GlobalTech.

agent.name: salesforce
agent.description: Reads Salesforce CRM data for the signed-in user: object schemas, accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, cases, recently viewed records, text search results, and related records. This server is read-only and cannot create, update, or delete Salesforce data.
agent.owns: You own the Salesforce org data the signed-in user is authorized to read, subject to Salesforce object permissions, field-level security, and sharing rules. Use describeSObject before unfamiliar queries, then use soqlQuery for known objects and fields; use soslSearch when the object is unknown and getRelatedRecords when a parent record and relationship are known. You can read and search only. You do not own other CRM systems, the source repository, or any Salesforce data outside the signed-in user’s permissions. When reporting Salesforce records, include the Salesforce record URL when one is available.

tool_descriptions.describeSObject: Returns Salesforce schema information optimized for LLM consumption. Call without parameters first for a compact index of queryable objects, then pass an object name for field-level details and relationship information.
tool_descriptions.soqlQuery: Executes a SOQL query to retrieve Salesforce records. Use a WHERE clause and a LIMIT clause, and use relationship queries or child subqueries when appropriate.
tool_descriptions.soslSearch: Executes a text search across multiple Salesforce objects. Use it when a search term may exist in multiple object types or the object containing the data is not known.
tool_descriptions.getUserInfo: Returns the authenticated Salesforce user’s identity and context, including user ID, name, email, role, profile, manager, local time, and timezone.
tool_descriptions.getRecentlyViewed: Returns records of a specified Salesforce object type that the user recently viewed or modified, ordered by last viewed date.
tool_descriptions.getRelatedRecords: Retrieves child records related to a Salesforce parent record by traversing a specified relationship path.
